desc: The Mark V Carbon Compact is a lightweight carbon barrel rifle built with a shorter length of pull for smaller statured shooters. It features the lighter 6-Lug Standard Action and is chambered in some of the most popular recoil friendly cartridges in the industry. The Monte Carlo inspired stock design helps manage recoil by directing force away from the shooter’s face, keeping them aligned and on target. The BSF carbon barrel delivers unmatched accuracy and comes with Weatherby’s Accubrake DST (Directional Self-Timing Brake).
